steps.en: Scaffold an app and pick your frontend framework
steps.zh: 生成项目骨架，选好前端框架

steps.en: Put native work in a Rust function and mark it as a command
steps.zh: 把原生能力写成 Rust 函数，标成命令

steps.en: Call that command from your frontend code
steps.zh: 在前端代码里调用这个命令

steps.en: Compiles the Rust side, opens a native window and renders your UI in the OS webview
steps.zh: 编译 Rust 部分，打开原生窗口，用系统自带的 webview 渲染界面

steps.en: Passes each invoke call across the bridge to your Rust function and back
steps.zh: 把每次 invoke 经桥接层转给你的 Rust 函数，再把结果送回

steps.en: Produces .msi/.exe, .app/.dmg, .deb/.rpm/.AppImage installers with no bundled browser
steps.zh: 产出 .msi、.dmg、.AppImage 等原生安装包，不带浏览器内核

value.en: A desktop app built from your web skills, whose installer does not carry its own copy of Chromium
value.zh: 用 Web 技能做出桌面应用，安装包里不用捎带一整个 Chromium

sources: https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri README (npm create tauri-app@latest, WRY/TAO, system webviews, bundle formats .app .dmg .deb .rpm .AppImage NSIS .exe WiX .msi)
